description: Optional inspiration palette of research paradigms. NOT consulted by runtime routing — the primary agent picks paradigms ad-hoc or selectively opens this file to pull one entry into a path brief. Full-catalog routing via match-signals.js is a contract violation (#203 AC9).

paradigms.name: Hypothesis-driven inquiry
paradigms.description: Generate competing hypotheses, design tests, update beliefs based on outcomes. Default Popperian paradigm for engage-crucible.

paradigms.name: Mechanistic reasoning
paradigms.description: Hypotheses explain phenomena by reference to underlying causal mechanisms. Mechanism specification is load-bearing for falsifiability.

paradigms.name: Causal-DAG modeling
paradigms.description: Hypotheses are formalized as directed acyclic graphs over variables. Confounders, mediators, and colliders are explicit nodes.

paradigms.name: Replication-first inquiry
paradigms.description: Hypotheses are framed around what replications would and would not be expected to show. Strong default for low-prior-credibility findings.

paradigms.name: Prediction-first inquiry
paradigms.description: Hypotheses are framed in terms of specific quantitative predictions, pre-registered before experiment. Reduces post-hoc rationalization.

paradigms.name: Natural-experiment inquiry
paradigms.description: Hypotheses leverage naturally-occurring exposure variation (policy changes, geographic discontinuities, instrumental variables) when controlled experiments are impossible.

paradigms.name: Comparative effectiveness
paradigms.description: Hypotheses compare two or more existing interventions against each other rather than against a null/placebo. Common in clinical and policy research.
